name: func_GuessName
original_purpose: Guess the player's real name from the host computer (used by the Prophet).
dreamcast_replacement: Copies the virtual computer's account name (Settings app, default 'Player') into actor 2.
failure_behaviour: No account name -> actor 2 keeps its current name; the Prophet still asks for a name.

name: func_SetName
original_purpose: Substitute the player's name for the _PlayerName_ placeholder in the next message.
dreamcast_replacement: The message renderer always replaces the placeholder with the stored player name.
failure_behaviour: Unknown name -> actor 2 name is used.

name: func_SetNameEntry
original_purpose: Store the name typed in EnterHeroName as the player's name.
dreamcast_replacement: Stores actor 2's name as the persistent player name (saved with the next commit).
failure_behaviour: Empty name -> rejected by the on-screen keyboard (cannot confirm empty input).

name: func_ShakeWindow
original_purpose: Shake the game window on the Windows desktop.
dreamcast_replacement: Shakes the whole screen for about one second (non-photosensitive path only, as in the data).

name: func_SetWallpaper
original_purpose: arg1=1: replace the desktop wallpaper with a clue image; arg1=0: restore it. return=1 on success.
dreamcast_replacement: Changes the virtual desktop wallpaper (persisted).  The clue wallpaper is generated at conversion time from the solution event M28E36.
failure_behaviour: If the clue image is missing: return=0 and a clue file is placed on the virtual Desktop instead (the data's own fallback branch).

name: func_MessageBox
original_purpose: Show a native Windows message box; arg1 selects the text; return=1 for OK/Yes.
dreamcast_replacement: Modal virtual system dialog; waits for the controller.  Texts are substitutes (originals are inside the obfuscated EXE).
failure_behaviour: Unknown id -> generic OK dialog, return=1.

name: func_LeaveWindow
original_purpose: Move the game window off screen at the ending.
dreamcast_replacement: Plays a window-leaving animation, then a simulated game close; the next launch boots through Map 1.

name: func_Save
original_purpose: Begin the one-slot save: snapshot switches/variables (incl. memorised location vars 21-23).
dreamcast_replacement: Snapshots switches/variables in RAM; the write happens when the item+skill streams end.

name: func_WriteItem
original_purpose: Stream item ids then note(skill) ids into the save; 0 terminates each list.
dreamcast_replacement: Collects ids; after the second terminator commits to the VMU (two-slot, CRC-verified) and keeps a RAM copy.
failure_behaviour: No VMU / full / write error -> progress kept in RAM for this power session and the player is told honestly.

name: func_Load
original_purpose: Load the save. return=0 none, 1 loaded, 2 loaded but the player's name is unknown.
dreamcast_replacement: Reads the newest valid VMU slot (or the RAM copy), restores switches/variables, prepares item/note streams.
failure_behaviour: Corrupt/unsupported save -> return=0 (new game) after an explanatory dialog; data on the card is not deleted.

name: func_ReadItem
original_purpose: Return the next streamed id (items, 0, notes, 0).
dreamcast_replacement: Returns ids from the restored lists.

name: func_Document
original_purpose: Write a document containing the 6-digit safe code (var 29) into the player's Documents folder.
dreamcast_replacement: Creates a text file in the virtual /Documents folder (persistent layer).
failure_behaviour: VFS full -> return=0 and a diagnostic; the safe stays unsolvable until space is available (never auto-solved).

name: func_End
original_purpose: Record which ending was reached (arg1 3 or 4) so later launches change.
dreamcast_replacement: Sets the persistent ENDING value (arg1-1, matching Map 1's checks) and commits immediately.
failure_behaviour: Commit failure -> value kept in RAM; the player is warned that a power-off will forget it.

name: func_SetCloseEnabled
dreamcast_replacement: Controls whether the virtual computer's 'Close OneShot' action is available.

name: _init handshake
original_purpose: Start-up handshake: switches 1-20 and vars 1-4 hold a signature; var1 must change from 8008135.
dreamcast_replacement: Clears the signature (switches 1-20, vars 1-4), sets var7 ENDING from persistent meta.
failure_behaviour: If not handled, Map 1 shows the original 'error' picture (game unplayable) - so it is always handled.
